title: Bakery and Summer
author: Casper Vasquez
blurb: Sable Kavanagh, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
